description: This file defines the LogicHook class which manages, loads, and executes logic hooks within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM framework. It provides methods to initialize hooks, scan directories for hook files, load hooks for modules, and execute hooks based on events.

classes.name: LogicHook
classes.description: Class managing the registration, loading, scanning, and execution of logic hooks in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of LogicHook, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setBean
methods.description: Assigns a SugarBean object to be used by hooks.

methods.name: getHooksMap
methods.description: Returns the internal mapping of hooks.

methods.name: getHooksList
methods.description: Returns the list of scanned hook files.

methods.name: scanHooksDir
methods.description: Scans a directory for PHP files, includes them, and builds the hook scan and map.

methods.name: loadHooks
methods.description: Loads hook files for a specific module or application.

methods.name: getHooks
methods.description: Retrieves the list of hooks for a module, optionally refreshing the cache.

methods.name: call_custom_logic
methods.description: Triggers the execution of hooks for a specific module event.

methods.name: process_hooks
methods.description: Executes the hooks associated with an event in a specific order.
